name: Coder Vibe Trade Service Areas & Quotes
author: oozye2

sections.description:
Built for plumbers, electricians, roofers and other local trades who work across several towns.

  • Services and Service Areas custom post types to describe what you do and where you work.
  • Landing page generator: pick services and towns, preview how many pages will be made, then create one draft page per combination (for example “Boiler repair in Dover”) from editable templates. Tokens: {service}, {area}, {business}, {phone}, plus {service_description} and {area_description} taken from each entry’s excerpt so every page can carry genuinely different text.
  • Safety controls against thin or duplicate content: pages are always created as drafts, a per-run cap applies, existing combinations are never duplicated, and combinations without a description can be skipped.
  • Structured data: valid LocalBusiness and Service JSON-LD (with areaServed) on generated pages, built from your business name, phone, address, opening hours and price range.
  • Quote request form via the [cvtsa_quote_form] shortcode with name, phone, email, postcode, service and message fields, a honeypot, a nonce and rate limiting. Requests are stored in a private “Quote Requests” list with New / Quoted / Won / Lost statuses and filters, and the site admin is emailed.

No external services, no tracking, no remote requests, no ads.

Shortcode

[cvtsa_quote_form] or `[cvtsa_quote_form service="123"]` to preselect a service by its post ID.

Privacy

The quote form stores name, phone, email, postcode, selected service and message in your site database and emails them to the site admin. If a submission fails validation, the entered values are kept in a single-use transient for up to 15 minutes so the form can be refilled. Data is not sent to third parties. The plugin registers suggested privacy policy text and WordPress personal data export and erasure support for quote requests.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Trade Areas > Settings and enter your business details.
  4. Add Services and Service Areas (write a unique excerpt for each).
  5. Go to Trade Areas > Generate Pages, preview, then generate drafts.
  6. Edit each draft, add unique local content, and publish.
sections.faq:
Will generated pages be published automatically?

No. They are always created as drafts, and a reminder is shown on the edit screen.

Will this create duplicate or thin content?

The plugin is designed to reduce that risk: use the excerpt of each service and town to supply different text, keep the “skip combinations without a description” option on, and edit each draft before publishing. A per-run cap limits how many pages can be created at once. Search engines may still treat near-identical pages as low value, so add real local detail.

Where is the schema added?

In the page head of pages created by the generator, once published, as JSON-LD. Business name is required for schema output. Developers can adjust it with the cvtsa_schema_data filter.

How do I change the opening hours format?

Use one line per entry such as Mo-Fr 08:00-17:00. Invalid lines are removed when saving.

How does spam protection work?

A hidden honeypot field, a WordPress nonce, and a limit of three requests per hour per visitor (filter cvtsa_rate_limit_max). Visitor IPs are hashed temporarily for the limit and never stored with requests. If you use full-page caching, exclude pages with the form or keep nonce lifetimes in mind.

Where do quote emails go?

To the notification email in settings, or the site admin email if left blank. Email delivery uses wp_mail, so an SMTP plugin is recommended for reliability.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Only the plugin settings are removed. Services, areas, quote requests and generated pages stay unless you tick “Delete all Services, Service Areas and Quote Requests when the plugin is deleted” in settings. Generated pages are never deleted.

Does it contact external services?

No.
